title: Girlfriend Boyfriend

description.main: Richard Kern's 2014 portrait book for the New York hair salon Shizen, pairing young men and women across its spreads against coloured studio backdrops. Shizen Books, edition of 300, designed by Peter Miles Studio.
description.extended:
Girlfriend Boyfriend is Richard Kern's 2014 portrait book for the New York hair salon Shizen. It pairs young men and women across its spreads against coloured studio backdrops, under a cover that fades from pink to blue.

Each spread puts a boy on the left page and a girl on the right. They are photographed head-on against seamless paper lit red, violet, orange, green or blue, most in their own clothes. Hair is by the salon's stylists Yoko, Koshi and Aki, styling by Stephanie Boone. The sitters include Petra Collins, Coley Brown, May Hong and Jesse Hudnutt. Shizen Books is the imprint of Salon Shizen in New York and its Tokyo sister salon The Oversea. It published the book in October 2014 in an edition of 300. The object is a 42-page stapled softcover of about 20 by 28 cm, designed by Peter Miles Studio with a pixel-font title on an Eska card cover. Kern's CV lists the publisher as The Oversea Books.

Kern (born 1954) came out of the Cinema of Transgression films of the 1980s. Since the 1990s he has worked mainly in still photography of young New Yorkers, published by Taschen, Picturebox, Innen and APE. This was his second book with Shizen after 10:41 (2011). The two salons worked with him again on Half Half (2019), which the library also holds.
